papers.abstract: World models simulate environmental dynamics to enable embodied agents to plan and reason about future states. While real-world perception is inherently multimodal, existing approaches focus primarily on visual observations, leaving crucial spatial and temporal acoustic cues underexplored. In this work, we present a unified formulation of Audio-Visual World Models (AVWM), casting multimodal environment simulation under action control as a partially observable Markov decision process with synchronized audio-visual observations. As a foundational benchmark, we construct AVW-4k, comprising 30 hours of action-annotated binaural audio-visual trajectories across 76 indoor environments. To capture these physically grounded multisensory dynamics, we propose AV-CDiT (Audio-Visual Conditional Diffusion Transformer), featuring a novel modality expert architecture that balances visual and auditory learning, optimized via a three-stage training strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AV-CDiT achieves high-fidelity prediction across both visual and auditory modalities. Furthermore, we validate its practical utility in embodied navigation, showing that AVWM significantly enhances a pretrained agent in continuous audio-visual navigation tasks.

analysis.key_results: AV-CDiT在视觉和听觉模态上均实现了高保真预测；在连续音频-视觉导航任务中，AVWM显著增强了预训练代理的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一的音频-视觉世界模型（AVWM）形式化框架，构建首个大规模动作标注的双耳音频-视觉数据集AVW-4k，并设计AV-CDiT架构及三阶段训练策略以平衡视觉与听觉学习。
analysis.method: 采用音频-视觉条件扩散Transformer（AV-CDiT），包含模态专家架构和三阶段训练策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一的音频-视觉世界模型（AVWM），将多模态环境模拟形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，并构建包含动作标注的双耳音频-视觉轨迹数据集AVW-4k，提出AV-CDiT架构实现高保真预测，并在具身导航中验证了其提升预训练代理性能的实用价值。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于世界模型（World Model），属于本站核心主题。通过整合音频和视觉模态，增强了具身代理在音频-视觉导航等任务中的规划与推理能力，与VLA/WAM中的世界建模方向高度相关。

papers.abstract: In web environments, user preferences are often refined progressively as users move from browsing broad categories to exploring specific items. However, existing generative recommenders overlook this natural refinement process. Generative recommendation formulates next-item prediction as autoregressive generation over tokenized user histories, where each item is represented as a sequence of discrete tokens. Prior models typically fuse heterogeneous attributes such as ID, category, title, and description into a single embedding before quantization, which flattens the inherent semantic hierarchy of items and fails to capture the gradual evolution of user intent during web interactions. To address this limitation, we propose CoFiRec, a novel generative recommendation framework that explicitly incorporates the Coarse-to-Fine nature of item semantics into the tokenization process. Instead of compressing all attributes into a single latent space, CoFiRec decomposes item information into multiple semantic levels, ranging from high-level categories to detailed descriptions and collaborative filtering signals. Based on this design, we introduce the CoFiRec Tokenizer, which tokenizes each level independently while preserving structural order. During autoregressive decoding, the language model is instructed to generate item tokens from coarse to fine, progressively modeling user intent from general interests to specific item-level interests. Experiments across multiple public benchmarks and backbones demonstrate that CoFiRec outperforms existing methods, offering a new perspective for generative recommendation. Theoretically, we prove that structured tokenization leads to lower dissimilarity between generated and ground truth items, supporting its effectiveness in generative recommendation. Our code is available at https://github.com/YennNing/CoFiRec.

analysis.key_results: 在多个公开基准和骨干模型上的实验表明CoFiRec优于现有方法；理论上证明了结构化分词降低生成物品与真实物品的不相似度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoFiRec框架和CoFiRec分词器，将物品信息分解为多个语义层级并独立分词，在自回归生成中逐步从粗粒度兴趣到细粒度物品兴趣建模用户偏好。
analysis.method: 结构化分词：将物品属性按语义层级（从类别到描述和协同过滤信号）独立分词，并指导语言模型按从粗到细顺序生成物品令牌。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoFiRec通过从粗到细的分层分词捕获物品语义层级，提升生成式推荐性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于生成式推荐中的分词与自回归生成，不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM）。其分层分词和结构化自回归生成思想可能对VLA/WAM中的动作或状态离散化有潜在启发性，但无直接技术关联。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies excel in aligning language, perception, and robot control. However, most VLAs are trained purely by imitation, which overfits to demonstrations, and is brittle under distribution shift. Reinforcement learning (RL) directly optimizes task reward and thus addresses this misalignment, but real-robot interaction is expensive and conventional simulators are hard to engineer and transfer. We address both data efficiency and optimization stability in VLA post-training via a learned world model and an RL procedure tailored to flow-based action heads. Specifically, we first introduce Prophet, a unified action-to-video robot world model pretrained on large-scale, heterogeneous robot data to learn reusable action-outcome dynamics and then few-shot adapted to new robots, objects, and environments, yielding a rollout-ready simulator. Upon Prophet, we reinforce action policies with our proposed FlowScale, which couples Flow-GRPO with intrinsic stepwise reweighting to stabilize gradients. Together, our solution provides a practical, data- and compute-efficient path to VLA post-training. Experiments show 5-17% success gains on public benchmarks and 24-30% on real robots across diverse VLA backbones.

analysis.key_results: 在公共基准测试上成功提升5-17%，真实机器人上提升24-30%，涵盖多种VLA基座。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个统一的动作到视频的机器人世界模型Prophet和一个与流式动作头匹配的RL过程FlowScale，为VLA后训练提供数据与计算高效的路径。
analysis.method: 使用大规模异构机器人数据预训练Prophet世界模型（动作到视频），再对新机器人少样本适配作为 rollout 模拟器，在此之上用FlowScale（Flow-GRPO 结合内在步级重加权）增强动作策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Prophet世界模型和FlowScale强化学习方法，实现VLA策略数据与计算高效的后训练，并在基准和真实机器人上显著提升成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接应用于VLA策略后训练，通过世界模型和高效RL解决了VLA的分布偏移和训练效率问题，对本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: We propose a framework that uses a world model as a real-world simulator to post-train VLA policies. Our world model Prophet is pretrained on large-scale robot trajectories to model action-to-video dynamics. The pretrained Prophet enables `prophesying' precise, physically plausible long-horizon rollouts, and can be rapidly adapted via few-shot fine-tuning to new environments, objects, and trajectories. Upon Prophet, we introduce the FA-GRPO with FlowScale RL algorithm to more stably and efficiently improve policies. Together, our training paradigm turns diverse logged data and a single pretrained world model into a unified engine for scalable, data-efficient, and safely improvable VLA systems.

Given an initial frame and instruction, the policy predicts an action chunk and Prophet generates the future robot rollout, updating the policy input, current frame, and history buffer until the episode ends. papers.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective approach to incentivizing reasoning capability in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), while the underlying mechanisms behind this post-training paradigm are poorly understood. We begin by exploring how input activations are affected by RLVR through the perspective of logit lens. Our systematic investigations across multiple post-trained LMMs suggest that RLVR shifts low-entropy activations unexpectedly, while high-entropy ones are less affected. We further demonstrate that such phenomena are associated with LMM reasoning by controlled experiments, suggesting a potentially beneficial role of modulating low-entropy activations. To this end, we propose Activation Replay, a novel simple yet effective training-free approach that boosts multimodal reasoning of post-trained LMMs without requiring expensive policy optimization. Our design involves manipulation of visual tokens at test time, replaying low-entropy activations from the input context of base LMMs to regulating the RLVR counterparts. Activation Replay triggers better reasoning across diverse scenarios, including mathematics, o3-like visual agents, and video reasoning. We further show that Activation Replay boosts Pass@K and mitigates narrower reasoning coverage of RLVR. Our design is compared against alternative choices, such as replaying high-entropy activations instead of low-entropy ones, or direct cross-model intervention instead of manipulating input tokens, demonstrating the superiority of our implementation. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/latentcraft/replay.

analysis.key_results: Activation Replay在数学、o3类视觉代理和视频推理等场景中提升了推理性能，并提升了Pass@K，缓解了RLVR的推理覆盖范围窄的问题。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Activation Replay，一种无需训练的方法，通过重放基础LMM输入上下文中的低熵激活来调节RLVR对应模型，从而提升多模态推理。
analysis.method: 在测试时操纵视觉token，从基础LMM的输入上下文中重放低熵激活，以调控RLVR模型的输出。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一种无需训练、通过重放低熵激活来提升大型多模态模型推理性能的方法，并揭示了RLVR对模型激活的影响机制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于大型多模态模型的推理增强，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模；其方法论可能对通用多模态模型的效率优化有参考价值，但与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.title: Boosting Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models via Activation Replay

papers.abstract: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have recently gained significant attention for their exceptional performance and inherent potential for parallel decoding. Existing frameworks further enhance its inference efficiency by enabling KV caching. However, its bidirectional attention mechanism necessitates periodic cache refreshes that interleave prefill and decoding phases, both contributing substantial inference cost and constraining achievable speedup. Inspired by the heterogeneous arithmetic intensity of the prefill and decoding phases, we propose ODB-dLLM, a framework that orchestrates dual-boundaries to accelerate dLLM inference. In the prefill phase, we find that the predefined fixed response length introduces heavy yet redundant computational overhead, which affects efficiency. To alleviate this, ODB-dLLM incorporates an adaptive length prediction mechanism that progressively reduces prefill overhead and unnecessary computation. In the decoding phase, we analyze the computational characteristics of dLLMs and propose a dLLM-specific jump-share speculative decoding method to enhance efficiency by reducing the number of decoding iterations. Experimental results demonstrate that ODB-dLLM achieves 46-162x and 2.63-6.30x speedups over the baseline dLLM and Fast-dLLM, respectively, while simultaneously mitigating the accuracy degradation in existing acceleration frameworks.

analysis.key_results: 在基线 dLLM 和 Fast-dLLM 上分别实现 46-162 倍和 2.63-6.30 倍加速，同时降低现有加速框架的精度退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ODB-dLLM 框架，通过双边界优化（预填充自适应长度预测与解码阶段 dLLM 专用跳转共享推测解码）加速扩散语言模型推理。
analysis.method: 预填充阶段采用自适应长度预测减少冗余计算；解码阶段设计 dLLM 专用的跳转共享推测解码方法以减少解码迭代次数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过自适应预填充长度预测和解码阶段的跳转共享推测解码，大幅加速扩散语言模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于扩散语言模型的高效推理，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人领域的直接应用，因此与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Time series forecasting drives operational decisions under tight latency budgets, and autoregressive time series foundation models (TSFMs) increasingly deliver the most accurate forecasts. That accuracy is paid for at inference, since a horizon of $H$ steps takes $\lceil H / P\rceil$ sequential forward passes of a large model, so latency grows with exactly the long horizons these models are prized for. Yet a far cheaper model predicts most next patches nearly as well as the large one, and causal models can verify a block of future patches in one parallel pass even though they generate them one at a time. These are precisely the conditions under which speculative decoding thrives in LLMs, but its ingredients are all defined over discrete vocabularies. We therefore develop speculative decoding for continuous patch autoregression. A cheap draft proposes $K$ future patches, and the target verifies all of them in a single causal pass, accepting each by a log-domain Gaussian likelihood-ratio test and correcting the first rejection with its own prediction. We prove that the accelerated output stays within a squared-error radius of target-only decoding set by an acceptance temperature, and that throughput follows a capped-geometric law that makes speedups predictable before deployment. The method delivers up to $3.0 \times$ inference speedup at accuracy between target and draft across five TSFM families, and we characterize which architectures admit single-pass verification and when speculation does not pay.

analysis.key_results: 在五个TSFM系列上达到最高3.0倍推理加速，精度介于目标模型和草稿模型之间。
analysis.main_contribution: 将离散令牌的投机解码扩展到连续补丁自回归，针对时间序列基础模型实现单次因果验证下的推理加速。
analysis.method: 廉价草稿模型提议K个未来补丁，目标模型在单次因果前向传播中验证所有补丁，通过对数域高斯似然比检验接受，并对首次拒绝进行修正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出面向连续补丁自回归的时间序列基础模型的投机解码方法，通过廉价草稿模型提议、目标模型并行验证实现推理加速。

papers.abstract: Deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices faces two critical challenges: maintaining accuracy under aggressive quantization while ensuring predictable inference latency. We present a curiosity-driven quantized Mixture-of-Experts framework that addresses both through Bayesian epistemic uncertainty-based routing across heterogeneous experts (BitNet ternary, 1-16 bit BitLinear, post-training quantization). Evaluated on audio classification benchmarks (ESC-50, Quinn, UrbanSound8K), our 4-bit quantization maintains 99.9 percent of full-precision F1 (0.858 vs 0.859) with 4x compression and 31 percent energy savings versus 8-bit, while both achieve statistical parity with full precision (p > 0.05). Crucially, curiosity-driven routing simultaneously improves accuracy and stability: on Quinn, F1 increases from 0.802 to 0.809 while cross-fold variance drops by 85 percent (p < 0.001, Levene's test), with reductions of 50 to 94 percent across datasets. The routing is self-organizing, with the high-precision 8-bit expert automatically receiving the most uncertain samples (20 percent lower confidence, p < 0.001), while lightweight experts handle easier inputs. Datasets with already low baseline variance show no artificial stability gain, confirming the mechanism targets genuine epistemic uncertainty rather than overfitting routing decisions. At 1.2M parameters, the framework provides interpretable, precision-aware routing suitable for safety-sensitive edge deployments where both accuracy and predictability are critical.

analysis.key_results: 在 ESC-50、Quinn、UrbanSound8K 上，4-bit 量化 F1 0.858 vs 全精度 0.859，4x 压缩，比 8-bit 节能 31%；在 Quinn 上 F1 从 0.802 提升到 0.809，方差下降 85%（p<0.001），跨数据集方差降低 50-94%；8-bit 专家自动接收最不确定样本（置信度低 20%，p<0.001）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出好奇心驱动的量化 MoE 框架，利用贝叶斯认知不确定性进行路由，在保持精度（4-bit 保持全精度 F1 的 99.9%）的同时实现 4 倍压缩、31% 能耗节省，并显著降低跨折方差（最高 94%）。
analysis.method: 基于贝叶斯认知不确定性的路由，跨异构专家（BitNet 三元、1-16 bit BitLinear、训练后量化）选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于贝叶斯认知不确定性的好奇心驱动量化专家混合框架，通过异构量化专家的自适应路由，在音频分类任务上同时保持精度、降低能耗并提升稳定性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于独立量化与高效推理，研究对象为音频分类，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人领域；其量化 MoE 和不确定性路由方法对未来机器人模型的高效部署有一定参考价值，但无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Despite the rise of billion-parameter foundation models trained across thousands of graphical processing units (GPUs), similar scaling gains have not been shown for humanoid control. Current neural controllers for humanoids remain modest in size, target a limited set of behaviors, and are trained on a handful of GPUs. We show that scaling model capacity, data, and compute yields a generalist humanoid controller capable of natural, robust whole-body movements. We position motion tracking as a scalable task for humanoid control, leveraging dense supervision from diverse motion-capture data to acquire human motion priors without manual reward engineering. We build a foundation model for motion tracking by scaling along three axes: network size (1.2M to 42M parameters), dataset volume (100M+ frames from 700 hours of motion capture), and compute (21k GPU hours). Beyond demonstrating the benefits of scale, we further show downstream utility through a real-time kinematic planner that bridges motion tracking to tasks such as navigation, enabling natural and interactive control, as well as a unified token space that supports virtual reality (VR) teleoperation and vision-language-action (VLA) models with a single policy. Through this interface, we demonstrate autonomous VLA-driven whole-body loco-manipulation requiring coordinated hand and foot placement. Scaling motion tracking exhibits favorable properties: performance improves steadily with compute and data diversity, and learned policies generalize to unseen motions, establishing motion tracking at scale as a practical foundation for humanoid control.

analysis.key_results: 性能随计算量和数据多样性稳步提升，学习到的策略能泛化到未见过的动作；展示了自主VLA驱动的全身移动操作能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了一个基于运动跟踪的人形机器人控制基础模型，通过扩展网络规模、数据集和计算资源，实现了自然、鲁棒的全身运动控制，并展示了其下游应用价值。
analysis.method: 以运动跟踪为核心任务，利用大规模动作捕捉数据进行稠密监督，在三个维度上扩展：网络规模（1.2M到42M参数）、数据量（100M+帧）和计算量（21k GPU小时），并设计了实时运动学规划器和统一token空间。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文展示了通过扩展模型容量、数据和计算规模，训练出能够自然、鲁棒地执行全身运动的人形机器人控制基础模型，并支持导航、VR遥操作和VLA驱动的全身操作。
